🏆 NAVI are Brawl Stars World Champions!

Ukrainian esports org Natus Vincere (NAVI) has won the Brawl Stars World Finals 2026, beating FUT 4-3 in a thrilling grand final in Tokyo to claim their first-ever Brawl Stars world title.

🔑 Key facts:
• Grand final result: NAVI 4-3 FUT
• Venue: Tokyo, Japan — around 7,000 fans attended live, the biggest Brawl Stars World Finals crowd yet
• This is NAVI's first-ever Brawl Stars World Championship title
• NAVI reportedly took home $450,000 in prize money (per UNITED24 Media)

🕐 Published: 19:53 GMT+3

📰 Sources: PR Newswire, UNITED24 Media

👥 Follow: https://x.com/natusvincere | https://x.com/BrawlStars
